# Top Hat

> > Top Hat provides interactive educational technology, customizable digital textbooks, and classroom engagement tools for higher education.

Top Hat serves colleges and universities with active learning platforms, the Top Hat Marketplace for interactive textbooks, and student engagement solutions. The platform supports diverse teaching methods from STEM courses to social sciences, with a focus on formative assessment and evidence-based pedagogy.

## Key Topics

- Student engagement
- Interactive textbooks
- Higher education technology
- Active learning
- Formative assessment
- Generation Z learning
- STEM education
- Classroom technology
- Digital course materials
- Teaching methods
- Top Hat Marketplace
- Educational innovation
- Course transformation
- Evidence-based pedagogy
- Academic rigor

- [Research Methods in Psychological Science Textbooks: Which Is The Best?](https://tophat.com/blog/research-methods-in-psychological-science): Comparison of research methods in psychological science textbooks

- [Organic Chemistry Is Hard and It Should Be](https://tophat.com/blog/organic-chemistry-rigor): Maintaining academic rigor while supporting student success in STEM courses
